macros.routedMix: 47 to Quantinuum Helios, mit, 64,000 shots; 3 to IBM Heron r3, mit, 64,000 shots
macros.rdSummary: The decoder beats the paired-mitigated arm in 18 of the 20 platform and shot combinations, the extrapolated arm in 13 and the reference-scaled arm in 2. At 1000 shots its error averaged over the five platforms is 164 K against 269 K for paired mitigation, 193 K for extrapolation and 118 K for reference scaling; at 64000 shots the four figures are 64, 38, 43 and 31 K.
